name: FusionFix
description: Fixes a long list of bugs and technical shortcomings in GTA IV that were never patched, and adds settings for modern systems: a graphics menu of its own, working shadows and reflections, a frame limiter, restored cut content, and Vulkan through DXVK as an alternative to DirectX 9. The largest and most widely used mod for the game.

sources.note: By ThirteenAG, from the project's own GitHub release - the same release the Legacy Addon in gfwl-stub comes from, so the two halves always match. 197 MB, mostly the update folder with textures and shaders.
